body: INTERIM HOLD REPAIR — bound before candidate freeze; no candidate SHA yet. Result schema v2 now requires model-observed normalized input, parser-state token echo, a versioned marker sidecar, and declared dialect. Admission supports only ExplicitIndexListV1, parses marker occurrences, and requires one-to-one ordinal rows with bounded provider node IDs plus nonempty sorted unique in-range token vectors exactly equal to rendered explicit markers before AmrCandidates runs. Provider node IDs and sidecar digest are retained in the attempt receipt. Added distinct A/B/C courts for ISI dialect, adjacent collapse, and gapped expansion; added concept plus literal-target success and swapped-occurrence rejection. Disabling vector equality yields exactly those three failures; accepting IBM dialect yields exactly court A failure. Unavailable now distinguishes unpinned, artifact missing, platform incompatible, and resource budget insufficient, all zero-call. Focused tests 53/53 and formatting green after rebase to current main 7385cf9; full compileAll testAll still pending.
